items.title: 古驰畅销款降价近30%，奢侈品涨不动了？客服回应
items.summary: Gucci cut prices on best-selling bags in China by roughly 30-40% in early September (Ophidia mini bucket bag 12,300 to 8,700 yuan; GG Marmont bucket bag under 10,000 yuan), reversing the industry's long-standing only-raise-never-cut pricing norm. Gucci customer service said the brand "periodically adjusts prices based on comprehensive market factors." Kering's H1 2026 results showed Gucci revenue down 5% comparably, with Asia-Pacific down 10%; the brand also closed 19 net stores.

items.title: 古驰大降价+新总监首秀，能重现辉煌吗？3个维度深度解读
items.summary: Weibo discussion thread analyzing whether Gucci's simultaneous China price cuts and Demna's creative-director debut can restore the brand's former standing. Frames the price cut as Kering's "trade quantity for price" tactic under the Rinascimento turnaround strategy, and notes some discounted items (e.g., Ophidia mini bucket bag) sold out and were pulled from shelves quickly after the markdown.

items.title: 古驰国内国外价差到底多大？2026年9月降价后最高省40%，代购还有优势吗？
items.summary: Consumer-angle Weibo post comparing Gucci's domestic-China vs overseas price gap after the September markdown, asking whether daigou (personal shopper/reseller) arbitrage still makes sense post-price-cut. Reflects price-sensitive shopper chatter following the official adjustment.

items.title: 一日连关两店，Gucci在中国"失宠"了吗？
items.summary: Trade/community analysis piece revisiting why Gucci lost favor with Chinese consumers, citing Gen Z commentary that the brand's "designs are increasingly boring" and a running joke of "never buy Gucci without a discount." Notes Gucci also underperforms on the resale/secondhand market, being described as unable to hold resale value versus peers.

items.title: Stray Kids リノ「GUCCI」のグローバルアンバサダーに抜擢
items.summary: Japanese entertainment/fashion press coverage of Stray Kids member Lee Know (Rino) being named a Gucci global brand ambassador, noting his prior attendance at Gucci's Cruise show in London and expectations that his cross-generational fan appeal will bring fresh energy to the brand in the NEA region.

items.title: 【GUCCI】グッチ アイウェア 2026年秋冬コレクションの新キャンペーンを発表
items.summary: Official Kering Japan press release announcing Gucci's Fall/Winter 2026 eyewear campaign, art-directed by Riccardo Zanola and shot by Mark Seliger, featuring black acetate frames with double-G and horsebit details. Straightforward brand activation/marketing coverage.

items.title: 구찌, 2026 가을·겨울 아이웨어 새 시선
items.summary: Korean lifestyle-desk coverage of Gucci's new Fall/Winter 2026 eyewear campaign, describing the portrait-style imagery of individuals in reflective, personal moments and detailing the double-G acetate frames and horsebit-detail sunglasses for the men's and women's lines.

items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？ 業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: WWD Japan trade analysis compiling harsh industry-analyst report cards on Demna's debut Gucci runway show, citing critiques that shoes and handbags were "boring," leggings drew criticism for looking cheap rather than sexy, and reactions were split between those who saw resonance with Gucci's identity and those who felt underwhelmed. A Bernstein analyst score of roughly 7.6/10 is referenced alongside more negative buyer commentary.

items.title: 「グッチ」にデムナ、賛否両論 否定派はディストピアなクリエイションを懸念
items.summary: WWD Japan trade coverage noting mixed (賛否両論) reception to Demna's appointment and debut vision for Gucci, with critics expressing concern the creative direction leans dystopian and diverges from the brand's heritage codes, while supporters argue it revitalizes the house.

items.title: 古驰成为首个冠名赞助F1车队的奢侈品牌，这背后有哪些商业战略考量？
items.summary: Background context piece (older but still actively referenced/re-shared in Sept discussion threads) on Gucci's landmark F1 Alpine title sponsorship starting 2027, the first time a luxury fashion brand has title-sponsored an F1 team, valued at an estimated $50-60M/year. Included for context; flagged as outside the 14-day freshness window and not counted toward buzz-fresh signal.

items.title: 古驰保值吗？2026年官方降价40%后，哪些款式还能扛价？
items.summary: Weibo consumer-advice post examining Gucci's resale/value-retention performance after the official 40% price cut, discussing which styles still hold resale value and implicitly acknowledging weaker secondhand-market pricing power versus competitors like Chanel and Hermes.

items.title: 구찌, 2026 가을·겨울 아이웨어 새 시선
items.summary: Syndicated Korean portal (Nate) republish of the Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 eyewear campaign announcement, covering the same Zanola/Seliger campaign details as other KR outlets; included to confirm cross-portal distribution and reach of the eyewear activation story in Korea.
